class InterfaceSuite:
    def time_mcp_inspect(self, _nodes: int) -> None:
        """Inspect the executable metric contract."""
        self.loop.run(
            get_metric(
                self.inspection,
                self.backend,
            )
        ).model_dump_json()

    def setup(self, nodes: int) -> None:
        """Prepare transport, event loop, catalog, and a bounded job-store fake."""
        self.catalog = catalog(installed(workload(1, "catalog", nodes).plugin))
        self.discovery = self.catalog.discovery
        self.jobs = Mock()
        self.jobs.enqueue.side_effect = lambda *_, **__: self.jobs.reset_mock()
        self.runtime = Mock(
            spec=ApplicationRuntime, catalog=self.catalog, jobs=self.jobs
        )
        self.backend = InProcessLyraBackend(lambda: self.runtime)
        self.temporary = TemporaryDirectory()
        path = Path(self.temporary.name) / "results.sqlite3"
        self.results = result_workload(1000, path)
    
        self.jobs.read_job.return_value = self.results.observation
        service = ResultService(self.jobs, path)
        self.runtime.results = service
        self.result_request = GetJobResultInput(job_id=self.results.native.id)
        self.loop = asyncio.Runner()
        app = FastAPI()
        app.state.runtime = Mock(
            spec=ApplicationRuntime, credentials=Mock(agent_api_key="fixture-key")
        )
        app.include_router(metrics.router)
        app.include_router(jobs.router)
        app.dependency_overrides[get_catalog] = lambda: self.catalog
        app.dependency_overrides[get_jobs] = lambda: self.jobs
        app.dependency_overrides[get_results] = lambda: service
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app),
            base_url="http://benchmark.invalid",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer fixture-key"},
        )
        self.request = JobCreateRequest(metric="source", inputs={}, parameters={})
        self.search = SearchMetricsInput(query="population")
        self.listing = ListMetricsInput()
        self.inspection = GetMetricInput(metric="source")

class AssemblySuite:
    def time_read(self, _graph: str) -> None:
        """Open storage and reconstruct all groups from the durable reference."""
        with ResultStore.open(self.execution.path) as reader:
            reader.read_result(self.reference)

    def setup(self, graph: str) -> None:
        """Publish a half-reused result before measuring reads."""
        self.execution = NodeCacheSuite()
        self.execution.setup(graph, "partial")
        result = self.execution.runner.run("root", inputs=self.execution.inputs)
